headline: <cite index="1-3">Nitco and House of Abhinandan Lodha enter MoU for 40-acre mixed-use development at Thal and Lonare in Alibaug</cite>
sum: Nitco Limited and House of Abhinandan Lodha have signed an MoU for a ₹4,500 crore mixed-use real estate development. The joint venture covers land parcels at Thal and Lonare in Alibaug, Raigad, with HoABL receiving ₹3,000 crore in revenue and Nitco ₹1,500 crore over five years. The project comprises apartments, townhouses, and a boutique luxury hotel to be operated under Miros.
implication: Joint development structures for land monetisation-particularly by non-core real estate players (here, a tiles manufacturer)-defer execution risk and capital intensity while capturing asset upside, a precedent for unlocking stranded land value in listed companies; MoU stage confirms the transaction remains subject to statutory approvals and definitive agreements.
detail: <cite index="1-3,1-4">The 40-acre project is expected to generate combined revenue of ₹4,500 crore: ₹3,000 crore for HoABL and ₹1,500 crore for Nitco over five years.</cite> <cite index="1-5">HoABL expects to invest around ₹1,000 crore in the project, largely towards construction.</cite> <cite index="2-9">In an exchange filing, Nitco disclosed receipt of a ₹9 crore security deposit cheque from its partner.</cite> <cite index="1-12,7-3">The transaction remains subject to conditions precedent, statutory approvals, and execution of definitive agreements.</cite>
